optimizedDescription.value: Detect raw project-relative implementation candidates from VCS changes since first implementing transition.

optimizedContext.value:
# VCS Implementation Detector

## Rules

- VCS-backed detector implements `core:implementation-detector-port` and remains replaceable.
- Obtain modified-file data through `core:vcs-adapter-port`; delegate VCS enumeration, never embed VCS commands directly.
- Baseline is first timestamp change entered `implementing`; resolve historical revision via `VcsAdapter.refAt(...)` and pass to `modifiedFiles(...)`. Fall back to `VcsAdapter.ref()` if missing/unresolvable.
- Rebase repository-root-relative VCS paths to configured project root; normalize separators to forward slashes; deduplicate and sort. Omit paths outside project root. Keep deleted/missing paths and rename sides inside project root.
- MAY apply generic caller-provided `excludePaths` from `ImplementationDetector` port. MUST NOT load graph config, apply Code Graph effective visibility (`allowedPaths`, graph defaults/exclusions), or derive graph fingerprints.
- Remain workspace-agnostic; return raw project-relative paths, never canonical `workspace:path`.

## Constraints

- Preserve raw project-relative semantics.
- Workspace validation and graph visibility filtering occur outside detector.
- Detector remains swappable through detector port.
